@copilot Update this PR directly to use any nonblank structured provider error code as error.type instead of restricting codes to the current eight-value allowlist. Do not create a separate follow-up PR as a workaround.

In instrumentation/openai/openai-java-1.1/library/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/openai/v1_1/OpenAiErrorType.java, remove the hard-coded allowlist and return the original nonblank string from OpenAIServiceException.code(). These codes come from the provider's error response, not an SDK enum, and OpenAI-compatible providers can define additional codes. Preserve exception-class fallback for non-service exceptions and missing, null, empty, whitespace-only, or malformed non-string codes, including the existing OpenAIInvalidDataException handling. Do not classify using error messages, trim or otherwise normalize accepted nonblank codes, or impose a new code pattern or replacement allowlist.

Update ServiceErrorTest.java so unknown/provider-specific nonblank codes are expected verbatim on both spans and operation-duration metrics across the existing sync/async chat, streaming-request-failure, and embeddings cases. Cover a provider-specific code on the existing async SSE terminal callback path as well. Retain missing/blank/malformed-code fallback coverage and the exact telemetry attribute assertions. Preserve the original PR's lifecycle, status, cancellation, and API scope; do not add Responses API instrumentation or blocking SSE iteration-error handling.

Update the existing README error-classification text and this PR's stale allowlist/cardinality claims to describe the new behavior accurately. The OpenAI GenAI semantic conventions permit provider/client error codes, canonical exception names, or another low-cardinality identifier; they do not prescribe an allowlist or these eight strings: https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/blob/main/docs/gen-ai/openai.md#inference . Do not claim arbitrary provider codes have a guaranteed cardinality bound. Keep any source comment focused on current behavior and use the semconv link only if an explanation is useful.

Run the repository's targeted formatting and relevant existing tests. Preserve this PR's draft/ready state and publish the intended changes to its existing head repository and branch.

replies.body: Implemented and pushed as `9772697`. Nonblank provider codes are now preserved verbatim with the existing fallbacks and coverage across the requested paths. I could not edit the PR body with the available tools, so its allowlist/cardinality wording remains stale and needs a manual update.

@copilot Simplify ServiceErrorTest.java's HTTP-error test matrix and update this PR directly. Do not create a separate follow-up PR as a workaround.

In instrumentation/openai/openai-java-1.1/library/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/openai/v1_1/ServiceErrorTest.java, separate payload-classification coverage from call-path wiring coverage. Run all 11 existing HTTP-error payload cases once through synchronous CHAT: context_length_exceeded at 400; insufficient_quota at 429; null, numeric 42, and object codes; empty and whitespace-only strings; provider_specific_code and its space-padded form; a missing code; and the unknown error shape. Preserve their existing expected values and exception-class fallback behavior. Use a straightforward Stream.of(...) payload provider instead of repeating the payload table inside the operation/async loops.

For each of the other five operation/async combinations, keep just two representative HTTP-error cases: a structured provider-specific code returned verbatim and a malformed non-string code using the exception-class fallback. This should reduce the HTTP-error invocations from 66 to 21 while retaining every payload case and all six call paths. Keep the parameterization and helpers simple; do not add a case-wrapper abstraction or duplicate the full payload table in new unit tests.

Keep asyncStreamTerminalError() separate and preserve all four existing cases and the successful initial chunk before the terminal SSE error. That test exercises the completion callback after streaming has begun, unlike an HTTP rejection. Preserve the exact span and operation-duration metric attribute assertions, error status, and exception assertions, including conditional stream and partial-response attributes. Keep production behavior, cleanup, lifecycle, and API scope unchanged; this request is only a test simplification.

Run targeted formatting and the relevant existing tests using repository guidance. Preserve this PR's draft/ready state and publish the intended changes to its existing head repository and branch.

replies.body: Implemented and pushed as `d70d8fb`. The 11 HTTP payload cases now run once through sync CHAT, and the other five operation/mode paths each run provider-specific and malformed cases. Both focused test executions pass (25 cases each), with async SSE and exact telemetry assertions preserved.
